User guide

Export and kt-cli

Render to MP4

File → Render to MP4… (or the render button) exports the region, or the whole project when no region is set.

SettingValues
Video codecAuto (hardware first) or any encoder your FFmpeg can open
QualityCRF 14–32 (default 23) or a bitrate of 0.5–80 Mbit/s
Audio bitrate128, 192, 256 or 320 kbps — AAC, 48 kHz stereo
Resolutionthe project's, 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p, or the largest source
ContainerMP4 with faststart

The file is named after the project, region marker and length, e.g. kt-song-chorus-4s.mp4. Before starting, the dialog warns about missing sources and about muted or solo tracks.

Rendering runs inside the editor through the system's libavcodec and libavformat. There are no temporary files and no external ffmpeg. It uses the same composition code as the preview, so the file contains what you saw. It can be paused.

kt-cli

kt-cli is the same engine without a window:

cd src
cargo run -p kt-cli -- <command> …
CommandWhat it does
versionprint the version
new <out.kt>an empty project
demo <out.kt> [--files]a demo project on synthetic sources (renders with no media at all)
showcase <out.kt> --sources <dir>a dense montage cut from every video in a directory — the README project
import <in.otio|in.ktproj> <out.kt>import OpenTimelineIO or an old Kinetren project
export-otio <in.kt> <out.otio>export OpenTimelineIO
roundtrip <in.otio> [out.otio]read and write OTIO back (a check of the exchange door)
render <in.kt> <out.wav> [--allow-missing]render the audio
export <in.kt> <out.mp4> [encoder]render video and audio to MP4
probe <in.kt> <from_s> <to_s> [--time]what plays in that range: effective events after morph layers, prefetch order, decode order; --time measures whether audio rendering keeps up with real time

--force lets any command overwrite an existing file. Without it, nothing is overwritten.

Judge speed only on a release build (cargo build --release -p kt-cli); the debug build is several times slower.

OpenTimelineIO

File → Export ▸ OpenTimelineIO… writes a self-contained .otio:

  • standard schemas for everything OTIO can express;
  • Kinetren's own data under metadata["kt"];
  • data from other programs kept untouched.

File → Import older Kinetren project… reads an .otio back into a new .kt.
